title: OF1 -- Research: move text-only notes to the Notes tab and let them be deleted
description: Screenshot docs/agent-work/2026-11-11-owner-fixes/1.png. Owner: 'on the research bar, there isnt a way to delete text only footnotes. Lets move the text only footnote thing to the notes side of the research bar so it doesnt share the section with sources'. Move the whole 'Text-only notes' block (heading, 'Insert footnote at cursor', the list with Used-in / Go to / Preview) out of the Sources tab into the Notes tab of the Research panel, and give each text-only footnote a Delete control with keyboard access, styled like the existing 'Delete note'. Deleting must also remove that footnote's marker from the document text, exactly the way deleting a cited footnote/source note already does today: find that existing path and reuse it; if no existing path removes a marker, STOP and block the task with what you found (this touches the owner's writing). Take a safety snapshot if the existing delete path does. src/App.tsx may need a small region edit to supply a handler: it is a shared file (Edit tool, small region, re-read first; do not register it). New spec tests/of1-text-notes.spec.ts, shown failing first. Port 1451. Owner hand-test report 2026-11-11 (he tried the real app; his report outranks any passing test). Rules: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/w9-brief.md, with notes in docs/agent-work/2026-11-11-owner-fixes/notes/<task>.md instead of the wave 9 notes folder. Before your first browser run, grep tests/ for every selector, label and class you change and update the specs that pin them (register each first). Run unit tests and tsc before any trip through the serial lock. Do not edit docs/*.md or AGENTS.md. No commits.

handoff.text: Delete flow, snapshot, cited-guard, Cancel/Esc and spec edits are fine. One regression: renderFootnote got a 2nd param extraActions but src/research/ResearchPanel.tsx:361 still calls {footnotes.map(renderFootnote)}, so Array.map passes the index and every cited footnote under a source renders a stray '0','1',... next to Unlink source (tsc cannot catch it). Fix: 1) change line 361 to {footnotes.map((note) => renderFootnote(note))}. 2) add one assertion (of1 or research spec) that a cited footnote's .item-actions text is exactly 'Unlink source', shown failing first. See docs/agent-work/2026-11-11-owner-fixes/REVIEW-r1.md
